data.description: The touch of an allip deals 1d4 points of Wisdom damage. A successful critical hit causes 1d4 points of Wisdom damage and 1 point of Wisdom drain (instead of double Wisdom damage). On each such successful attack, an allip gains 5 temporary hit points.
data.name: Touch of Insanity
